xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4860: pan project add proposes an issue prefix with digits, which parseIssueId rejects

plan.title: pan project add proposes an issue prefix with digits, which parseIssueId rejects
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: The project-create resolver (src/lib/projects/create.ts step 5) proposes key.toUpperCase().replace(/-/g,'').slice(0,10) and validates ^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]{0,9}$, so a key with digits (pan4774-anywhere-smoke) gets prefix PAN4774ANY. parseIssueId (src/lib/issue-id.ts:42) accepts letters-only prefixes (^([A-Za-z]+)-(\d+)$), so no issue ID for that project parses and resolveProjectFromIssue returns null.
narratives.Proposal: Make creation letters-only: the proposal keeps only A-Z (key.toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z]/g,'').slice(0,10)), validation becomes ^[A-Z]{1,10}$, and the issue-prefix-invalid message states the letters-only rule. parseIssueId is not widened. Add create-intent tests including a parseIssueId round-trip, and document the rule in configuration/projects.mdx, sync-sources/skills/pan-new-project/SKILL.md, and docs/WORKSPACES-AND-PROJECTS.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Widening parseIssueId, parseIssueIdFromText (src/lib/resource-utils.ts), or any of the ~67 LETTERS-NUMBER regexes to accept digits
- Migrating or repairing existing projects.yaml entries with digit prefixes (e.g. T2OOSDP on the operator machine)
- A pan doctor check for existing invalid prefixes
- Any frontend change in the Add-project dialog (ProjectCreateForm.tsx renders the server finding message)
- Auto-uppercasing an explicit lowercase --issue-prefix
- Changing src/cli/commands/project.ts (its linearTeam prefix already flows through the resolver at line 170)

autoDecisions.summary: Fix the create resolver to letters-only instead of widening parseIssueId to [A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*
autoDecisions.rationale: About 67 non-test regex sites (compose project names, specialist session names, feature-<id> dirs, branch refs, reapers, parseIssueIdFromText) hard-code the letters-only LETTERS-NUMBER shape; widening only the parser leaves digit-prefixed projects silently missed everywhere else. Projects that genuinely need digits already have issue_pattern.

autoDecisions.summary: A key with no letters (e.g. 2048) yields issue-prefix-invalid with empty detail and no proposal
autoDecisions.rationale: Matches today's behavior for digit-leading keys and avoids a synthetic fallback prefix that could collide with another project; the operator supplies --issue-prefix or the Options field.

autoDecisions.summary: Existing digit prefixes (T2OOSDP) are not migrated
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue is about create-time agreement; editing operator config is outside the change and the operator can rename or add issue_pattern.

narrative.Action: In src/lib/projects/create.ts step 5 (anchor '// 5. Issue prefix.', ~line 810): change the proposal to (input.issuePrefix ?? key.toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z]/g, '').slice(0, 10)).trim(); change the validation regex from /^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]{0,9}$/ to /^[A-Z]{1,10}$/; change the issue-prefix-invalid message to 'Issue prefix must be 1 to 10 uppercase letters (A-Z), with no digits.' and add a short comment citing parseIssueId's letters-only standard format and PAN-4860. Leave the issue-prefix-taken branch, parseIssueId, and project.ts unchanged. Do not grow create.ts past its origin/main line count. In tests/unit/lib/projects/create-intent.test.ts, import parseIssueId from '../../../../src/lib/issue-id.js' and add (mode 'new', homeBoundary true, homeDir TEST_HOME): name 'abc123-x' => proposedIssuePrefix 'ABCX', no issue-prefix-invalid finding, parseIssueId('ABCX-1') matches { prefix: 'ABCX', format: 'standard' }; name 'pan4774-anywhere-smoke' => 'PANANYWHER'; explicit issuePrefix 'BAD1' => issue-prefix-invalid with detail 'BAD1', null proposedIssuePrefix, message contains 'uppercase letters' and not 'letters and digits'; name '2048' => issue-prefix-invalid with detail '' and null proposedIssuePrefix. Existing MYNEWPROJE/THISISAVER tests stay unchanged and green. See PRD WI-1.

items.title: Given name 'abc123-x', when resolveProjectCreateIntent runs, then it returns proposedIssuePrefix 'ABCX' and parseIssueId('ABCX-1') returns prefix 'ABCX' with format 'standard'

Given explicit issuePrefix 'BAD1', when the resolver runs, then it emits an issue-prefix-invalid finding with detail 'BAD1' whose message contains 'uppercase letters' and does not contain 'letters and digits'
Given name '2048', when the resolver runs, then it emits issue-prefix-invalid with detail '' and returns a null proposedIssuePrefix

The branch's changes leave src/lib/issue-id.ts and src/lib/resource-utils.ts untouched (git diff $(git merge-base origin/main HEAD) HEAD on them produces no output) and the existing MYNEWPROJE and THISISAVER tests still pass
Document the letters-only issue prefix rule

grep prints the updated detected-configuration sentence in WORKSPACES-AND-PROJECTS.md

narrative.Action: Apply PRD WI-2 edits verbatim: configuration/projects.mdx line ~95 (issue_prefix bullet: proposed from the letters of the project key, digits and dashes dropped, up to ten characters; a key with no letters gets no proposal, pass --issue-prefix) and line ~244 (issue_prefix table row: append that it is 1 to 10 uppercase letters, digits rejected because IDs must match LETTERS-NUMBER, use issue_pattern otherwise); sync-sources/skills/pan-new-project/SKILL.md line ~110 (Issue prefix row Notes: 1–10 uppercase letters, no digits); docs/WORKSPACES-AND-PROJECTS.md line ~209 (a proposed issue_prefix (the key's letters only, max 10)).
